notes.title: September major update
notes.content:
We published Survival Driver now big updates. Here is list of all updates that has published:

- Some road textures changed
- sportbike, crossbike and sportcar handling changed
- game optimited. Project is now smaller
- added 4 new track
- crossbike level 6 track replaced new track

Totally Survival Driver has now 20 tracks

notes.title: Bugfix patch 1.0
notes.content:
Survival Driver has got first bugfix batch

It contains:

- Fixed collision for trees
- Fixed timecounter problem 
- Fixed sportlevel 5 Finishline crash problem

- Crossbike level 3 has still some texture problems. Few rocks missing textures in steam version. Texture missing will be fixed next week bugfix batch
